capability.summary: Check one source file with clang-format dry-run mode without rewriting it
capability.description: Runs `clang-format --dry-run --Werror <file>` for one existing source file. It reports formatting violations through clang-format's exit code and captured diagnostics while leaving the file unchanged.
capability.problem_space: Read-only clang-format compliance for a single supported source file; not source formatting, compiler diagnostics, semantic C/C++ linting, or multi-file project traversal.

constraint.io_signature: Input: one required existing source file path accepted by clang-format; output: a JSON process envelope with exit code and full stdout/stderr diagnostics.
accepted_inputs: an existing C, C++, Objective-C, Java, JavaScript, or other source file supported by the installed clang-format
constraint.output_shape: Completed check (clang-format exit 0 or 1): {status: "success", tool: "clang-format", target: string, exit_code: 0|1, result: null, stdout: string, stderr: string|null}; exit 0 indicates no `--Werror` formatting violation and exit 1 commonly reports a formatting violation. Other exits use the same keys with status="tool_error" and propagate the actual exit code. Missing path/executable/120-second timeout: {status: "error", tool: "clang-format", message: string}, exiting 2/3/4. Missing argument prints usage to stderr and exits 1 without JSON.
limitations: fixed `--dry-run --Werror` flags make this check-only; it never applies clang-format changes
checks one supplied file and does not recursively discover project files
does not expose style or fallback-style arguments; clang-format may discover configuration according to its normal rules
requires `clang-format` on PATH, uses a 120-second timeout, and captures output without parsing or truncation

output_contract.description: JSON envelope with clang-format dry-run status, actual exit code, target, and full stdout/stderr; the source file is not modified.

json_schema.description: Native JSON representation only; no field or task-delivery guarantee.

intent_tags: check a source file for clang-format compliance
run clang-format dry-run with formatting violations as errors
negative_intents: rewrite or automatically format source files
lint C or C++ semantics or compile source code
